baseline_models.focus_anchor: The agent noun in 78:22 is rooted in ط غ ي, and its predicate noun is rooted in ء و ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Crossing a proper bound supplies the initiating motion, while a return-place supplies its counter-motion. Their pairing makes the endpoint answer the excess rather than merely naming an unrelated destination.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping the bound in rebellion supplies the focus category and makes boundary violation the model's initiating motion.
Turning back to a return-place supplies the answering motion and gives the excess a determinate terminus.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely assigns wrongdoers a destination.
changed_reading.after: Those defined by passing beyond a bound are assigned the point at which their outward movement turns back.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root ط غ ي includes a material overflow branch, while مآبا retains the ء و ب return-place branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can image transgression as a force that rises and sweeps beyond measure. Pairing that force with a return-place makes the endpoint function as containment or rechanneling of an overflow.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing and overwhelming force materializes the transgressors as motion that has exceeded its measure.
The place to which motion returns acts as the receiving point for the excess.

changed_reading.before: Transgression is only an ethical label, and the return-place is static.
changed_reading.after: The transgressors can be carried as an overflowing force whose assigned return-point contains and reverses its surge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory for ط غ ي supplies both false authority and the overbearing tyrant, while ء و ب supplies return to a place.
baseline_models.mechanism: A person or power that claims authority beyond its proper limit is given its own assigned direction of return. The clause can therefore reverse the transgressor's attempt to orient or coerce others.

activation_trace.role: False authority or a head of misguidance supplies an illegitimate center that tries to direct others.
The overbearing tyrant sharpens the social form of limit-crossing as coercive rule.
Return to an assigned place redirects the would-be director and limits the claimed jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: The plural denotes undifferentiated sinners going to an abode.
changed_reading.after: It can specifically expose coercive or false authorities as powers themselves redirected to an assigned terminus.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated state-making and peg-like stability establish an ordered world; an appointed separation then exposes limits, and even the mountains are displaced into mirage. In that sequence, the طاغين are not only rule-breakers but agents exceeding a made and measured order, while their مآب is an appointed reassignment when that order is reset.

activation_trace.role: Passing beyond a proper bound anchors the focus category in violation of measure.
The return-place gives the measured order a terminus to which boundary-crossing motion is reassigned.
Making something assume a condition supplies the repeated assignment of created states.
Peg-like upright fixity supplies the stabilizing limit within the created arrangement.
Separating things until their boundary appears makes the decisive day a revelation of limits.
Limiting something by a time or endpoint supplies temporal measure to the separation.
Displacement and removal undo the apparent permanence of the world's stabilizers.
A waterlike mirage supplies the unstable appearance left when fixed terrain is reset.

structural_cues: The repeated state-making of 78:6 and 78:9-13 precedes the appointed day in 78:17.
The mountains move from pegs in 78:7 to displaced mirage in 78:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assigned states, stabilizers, explicit limits, and their later displacement; I infer that exceeding the bound violates this measured architecture and that return restores assignment; alternatively, the creation sequence may demonstrate power without defining the transgressors' mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The transgressors violate an unspecified rule and later reach a destination.
changed_reading.after: They exceed the limits of a deliberately assigned order, and their return-place is the appointed reassignment exposed when that order is separated and reset.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding watchpost-on-a-road image turns مآب from a passive home into an interception point. The transgressors' outward movement carries them onto a watched route whose prepared receiving station is also their return-place.

activation_trace.role: Bound-crossing supplies the outbound movement that enters the watched route.
The place of return becomes the route's receiving terminus rather than a merely static residence.
A place of watching on a road supplies the interception geometry that sharpens the following return-place.

structural_cues: 78:21 predicates Jahannam as a mirsad, and 78:22 immediately follows with the lamed allocation and maab.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent watched road-station followed by a return-place; I infer that the first functions as the route-mechanism of the second; alternatively, the two nouns may be independent descriptions joined only by adjacency.

changed_reading.before: The return-place is simply where the transgressors eventually reside.
changed_reading.after: It is a prepared interception point on the very route produced by their boundary-crossing motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended staying gives the return-place duration, while recompense, exact correspondence, exhaustive counting, and binding record give it measure. The مآب becomes a durable adjudicated output whose form corresponds to recorded conduct rather than an arbitrary location.

activation_trace.role: The exceeded bound supplies the conduct that the later sequence measures.
The return-place is revised into the durable output of the measuring process.
Staying in a place supplies residence rather than momentary arrival.
The extension of a long period stretches that residence across successive duration.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return-place's adjudicative function.
A measure equal to its counterpart makes the outcome correspond rather than remain arbitrary.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies complete input to the correspondence.
A binding written determination turns the counted input into an enforceable outcome.

structural_cues: 78:23 extends residence through ahqab, 78:26 names recompense as corresponding, and 78:29 counts every thing into a record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies duration, act-for-act recompense, equivalence, counting, and binding record; I infer that these are stages generating the quality of the return-place; alternatively, they may only describe consequences within an already fixed abode.

changed_reading.before: The maab is a preassigned punitive place with no visible relation to prior conduct.
changed_reading.after: It is a long-duration, recorded, and proportioned outcome that returns exceeded bounds to the agents who crossed them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-identical allocation for the protected and their mafaz turns 78:22 into one half of a paired outcome structure. Boundary-crossing and self-protection become opposed postures, while maab and mafaz become opposed route termini rather than generic place labels.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding the bound supplies one posture in the parallel allocation.
The return-place supplies the adverse terminus paired against the later mafaz.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the posture opposed to crossing the bound.
The mafazah poised between deliverance and destruction supplies a route-sensitive counter-terminus.

structural_cues: The syntax of 78:31 mirrors 78:22: a lamed plural category is followed by an indefinite outcome noun.
The two allocations place posture and outcome in direct opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies syntactically paired categories and route-outcomes; I infer that keeping within protection versus crossing bounds determines the opposed termini; alternatively, the parallel may be rhetorical contrast without a shared route mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The clause independently says where transgressors go.
changed_reading.after: It is the adverse half of a paired routing: unprotected boundary-crossing reaches maab as protected passage reaches mafaz.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing court scene concentrates lordship, denies others possession of address, straightens all ranks, and permits only authorized right speech. This makes the focus transgressor's tyrannical or false authority a claim beyond jurisdiction, and makes مآب a return from self-claimed sovereignty into the sole ordering authority.

activation_trace.role: False authority supplies a rival center that illegitimately directs others.
The overbearing tyrant supplies the coercive social form of the exceeded limit.
Return to an assigned place becomes repatriation from claimed jurisdiction.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the legitimate center of the closing order.
Dominion and sovereignty, explicitly unavailable for address here, strip rival powers of control.
Reciprocal address supplies the controlled public act that no one independently possesses.
Alignment on a straight line replaces self-elevated hierarchy with ordered rank.
Permission and authorization make valid agency jurisdiction-dependent.
Rightness settled opposite error limits even authorized speech to what lands correctly.

structural_cues: 78:37 denies possession of address under the Lord of the heavens and earth.
78:38 orders the spirit and angels in a row and restricts speech by permission and correctness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sole lordship, dispossessed speech, straight ranks, authorization, and correctness; I infer that the focus tyrant oversteps precisely these jurisdictional limits and is returned under them; alternatively, the closing scene may constrain every creature without specially defining طاغين as rulers.

changed_reading.before: The transgressors are generic rebels sent back to punishment.
changed_reading.after: They can be false or coercive authorities whose return is dispossession: claimed sovereignty, rank, and speech are brought back under sole jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact noun مآبا reappears in a willed act of taking a route toward the Lord. This recurrence makes the noun itself directionally neutral: its adverse force in 78:22 comes from the transgressor allocation and the preceding destination, while 78:39 shows a deliberately adopted Lordward return.

activation_trace.role: Boundary-crossing identifies the travelers whose relation makes the focus return adverse.
The return-place supplies the repeated semantic core whose valence is tested by 78:39.
Will directed toward an object supplies volitional orientation to the later return.
Taking or acquiring supplies the active adoption of a return-route rather than passive arrival.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the expressly named orientation of the adopted route.
The same return-place branch in a Lordward construction demonstrates that maab does not lexically encode punishment.

structural_cues: The same surface noun maaban closes both 78:22 and 78:39.
In 78:39 the noun is governed by a willed taking toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact noun repetition inside opposed relational frames; I infer that path and traveler determine the return's valence rather than the noun alone; alternatively, the same noun may simply name two context-specific destinations without a deliberate route contrast.

changed_reading.before: Maab itself names a punitive abode.
changed_reading.after: Maab names returnward direction; in 78:22 it becomes adverse through its allocation to boundary-crossers, while 78:39 preserves a willed return toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final warning compresses the return into temporal nearness and makes each person inspect what the hands advanced. The focus maab can therefore be read as a loop in which forward-sent acquisitions await the boundary-crosser and return as the encountered outcome.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding the bound supplies the agent's initiating conduct.
The return-place closes the loop between the acting agent and the advanced output.
A warning that awakens caution makes the return actionable before arrival.
Temporal nearness and approaching completion collapse the imagined distance to the outcome.
Directed sight or insight supplies personal inspection of the returned result.
Advancing something forward supplies the temporal vector by which deeds precede their agent.
What the two hands acquire identifies the advanced material as the person's own enacted output.

structural_cues: 78:40 moves from near warning to a person's inspection of what the hands sent ahead.
The forward vector of deeds closes the surah after the two maab formulations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, inspection, forward movement, and hand-acquired deeds; I infer a feedback loop in which maab is encounter with one's own advanced output; alternatively, the deeds may be evidence presented at return without generating the place's character.

changed_reading.before: The return-place is externally imposed and remote from the transgressors' actions.
changed_reading.after: It is the near encounter where their own forward-sent acquisitions return upon them as outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes a moral agent noun through its flood branch and links separated liquid scenes; it remains valid because both overflow and return-place are explicit focus branches and the context repeatedly supplies pouring, growth, denied drink, hot water, and outflow; downstream prose should label it a hydrological analogy, not claim that طاغين lexically means water or that maab literally means basin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ط غ ي overflow branch gives the focus agent a surging material profile, and the ء و ب branch gives that surge a receiving return-point.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing force supplies the material profile that links the focus agent to the surah's controlled and destructive flows.
The return-place functions analogically as the receiving point of the excess.
Water delivered by watering or pouring supplies the earlier controlled flow.
Pouring and downflow intensify the productive hydraulic movement.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the life-producing result of bounded flow.
A share of water, here denied in the surface sequence, converts access to flow into deprivation.
Hot water supplies the harmful liquid that replaces ordinary refreshment.
Outflow and pouring complete the reversal from productive to destructive hydraulics.

changed_reading.before: Moral transgressors are sent to a place unrelated to the surah's water cycle.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, overflowers are returned to a counter-basin where the flow that earlier generates life reappears as denied or harmful liquid.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant high-outcrop branch of ط غ ي against the mountain reversal; it remains anchored in a packet-supplied focus branch, the focus return-place, and the same-surah movement from solid mountains to mirage; downstream prose should render it only as a spatial metaphor for presumed elevation or security, not as the lexical sense of طاغين in 78:22.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus branch images ط غ ي as a smooth high outcrop, while مآبا supplies the point to which that elevated position is returned.

activation_trace.role: The smooth rock or high outcrop supplies an unusual spatial image of self-secured elevation.
The return-place supplies the terminus after apparent high ground is removed.
An elevated solid mass supplies the surah's initial image of dependable high ground.
Peg-like fixity intensifies the initial security of the elevated mass.
Displacement and removal reverse the earlier fixed elevation.
The same elevated solid mass is now the object whose stability is undone.
The shining waterlike mirage replaces solid high ground with appearance lacking support.

changed_reading.before: The transgressors' status has no spatial texture, and return is simple transfer.
changed_reading.after: Their presumed high ground can be carried as an unstable elevation that is displaced into mirage before they are returned to their actual terminus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the focus return through the night-return branch and the surah's daily timing before setting it against age-long residence; it remains anchored in the ء و ب focus inventory and packet-native sleep, night, day, appointment, and duration cues; downstream prose should call it a temporal or circadian activation, not assert that maab in 78:22 specifically means nightfall.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun مآبا has a branch of coming back with the night, allowing its return to be tested against the surah's recurring day-night sequence.

activation_trace.role: Night visitation or return supplies a recurring temporal profile for the focus maab.
Boundary-crossing identifies the agents whose return-cycle is altered.
Sleep supplies the recurring suspension within the daily cycle.
Rest and stillness give the suspension a restorative function.
Night supplies the phase to which the focus return branch explicitly resonates.
Day opening in light supplies the complementary phase that normally resumes activity.
A struck appointment converts recurring time into a decisive scheduled transition.
Remaining in place arrests the ordinary movement through phases.
Extended periods stretch the arrested phase far beyond daily recurrence.

changed_reading.before: The return is a single spatial arrival with no relation to recurring time.
changed_reading.after: The maab can be heard against daily return rhythms, but for the boundary-crossers the appointed transition arrests recurrence into an age-long residence.

strongest_changes: The exact reuse of maaban in 78:39 separates the noun's returnward core from its adverse allocation in 78:22.
The adjacent mirsad and the later duration, correspondence, count, and record turn the return-place into a monitored and calibrated outcome.
The parallel mafaz allocation and the closing jurisdiction over rank and speech sharpen both route contrast and the false-authority branch of the transgressors.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus clause function as a hinge: created measure and its dismantling precede it, while calibrated residence, an opposed route, jurisdictional ordering, a second maab, and self-advanced deeds unfold after it. The same two focus roots therefore sustain causal, spatial, legal, social, temporal, and material readings without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The created-order sequence may define the mechanism of transgression, or it may only establish power and timing around an independently moral category.
The hydrological, high-ground, and circadian activations are packet-anchored but should remain exploratory metaphors rather than lexical substitutions.
The second maab strongly exposes a shared returnward core, but the degree to which 78:22 and 78:39 form a deliberate choice-versus-compulsion contrast remains inferential.
